claims.statement: Let F be balanced with I(F)>1, rho=H(F)/(I(F)-1), L=I(F)-1, and let coordinate j have Inf_j(F)=1-epsilon with 0<=epsilon<=1/2. If V is the common output variance of the gauged children F_+ and -F_-, then at least one nonconstant raw restriction G in {F_+,F_-} satisfies H(G)/I(G) >= rho-[(rho+2/ln2)epsilon+V h2(epsilon/V)]/(L+epsilon). The sharper exact version replaces the numerator correction by rho epsilon + Delta_j H.
hypotheses: F is a finite genuine Boolean function on the uniform cube
V is the common child variance after the character gauge

claims.statement: Let M_{n-1}=max H(g)/I(g) over nonconstant Boolean g on at most n-1 variables. For balanced F on n variables with rho=H(F)/(I(F)-1)>M_{n-1}, put gamma=rho-M_{n-1} and L=I(F)-1. Every coordinate with Inf_j(F)=1-epsilon>=1/2 satisfies gamma L <= V h2(epsilon/V)+(M_{n-1}+2/ln2)epsilon <= h2(epsilon)+(M_{n-1}+2/ln2)epsilon. Hence every high-influence coordinate is quantitatively separated from 1 by the inverse of the strictly increasing displayed function; in particular no strict new record has an influence-one coordinate.
hypotheses: rho exceeds the exact lower-dimensional ordinary FEI record M_{n-1}
the coordinate considered has influence at least 1/2

claims.statement: Prove a gap-free descent-or-payment alternative: if the strict dimension-record gap degenerates while a high-influence coordinate approaches the character boundary, then either one genuinely descends to a lower-dimensional ordinary Boolean function without losing the target ratio, or exact hierarchy/I-projection/Booleanity credit pays the suspension loss rho epsilon + Delta_j H. Equivalently exclude an extremizing sequence with gamma(I-1)->0 and epsilon->0 that does neither.
